data: What is the performance value of the orange dashed line in the figure labeled (a)?

The question asks for the performance value of the orange dashed line in the figure labeled (a). From the caption, we know that the performance for the STS dataset is represented by the Pearson Correlation Coefficients (×100), while for the SICK-E and SST2 datasets, it is test accuracy. The orange dashed line corresponds to the STS dataset. 

In the figure labeled (a), the orange dashed line appears to be at approximately 85 on the y-axis. Therefore, the performance value of the orange dashed line in the figure labeled (a) is around 85.
